title: Kenworth T909 FUPS Compliant Custom Built polished Aluminium Road Train Bullbar #89
description: Kenworth T900, T908, T909, T950 FUPS compliant polished Road Train hi-tensile aluminium Bullbar. Extended main channel with Radar cutout with skirt and led light mounts. 88mm pipe and a full width cross pipe above headlights. All cross pipes are one piece and pass through the drilled uprights, no butt welds. The heavy duty box uprights are 6mm wall high tensile aluminium for maximum strength and protection. Flip over aluminium Road Train signs with engraved with Company Logo. Heavy duty high tensile aluminium backing plate with 38mm tow pin. Main bumper channel with heavy duty Company Logo engraved return panel to match mudguard contour. The centre bar is a custom made extrusion that will mount a light bar. Optional 76mm or 100mm diameter tube is available on request.
